label: 'Starting at' price excludes mandatory destination/delivery fees
description: Headline 'starting at' prices are quoted before the mandatory destination/delivery charge ($1,390 for Tesla, $1,995 for Ford, etc.) which every buyer pays. The actual MSRP a buyer encounters at order placement is consistently $1,000–$2,500 higher than the advertised number.
regulatory_basis: FTC has issued guidance on 'all-in' pricing under §5 of the FTC Act, primarily targeting hotels and rental cars. Auto-industry destination charges are conventionally excluded from advertised MSRP; this is widely accepted but creates systematic under-quoting in marketing.
consumer_harm: Buyers compare vehicles on advertised MSRP and arrive at the order page to find a higher delivered price. Lease and finance calculators built on the headline number understate monthly payments.
